title: QSR17: tensor leaves and direct adjacent-pair known-frequency roots

claims.statement: For QSR17 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the SAME fixed program (exhaustive n<2^20, exact multiway stream ranks with tensor leaves and direct adjacent-pair roots otherwise, keeping all known W for odd-part recovery and only odd W for two-adic parity) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability>2/3. On EVERY branch its T=O(n^(19/4)(log2n)2^((5/4)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2n)+(25/16)sqrt(n)(log2n)^(-1/4))), jointly with the other resource bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute; every source filter, discarded tree, loop/gate/address generation, monitor access, record, preparation, inverse and cleanup is charged. The stated representative applies for n>=2, with n=1 fixed. No distant analytic threshold or hidden exponential O coefficient is used.
